metadata.coordinate_reference: GeoJSON coordinates are WGS84 longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326); polygons were digitized in EPSG:32618.

metadata.omitted_classes: No roof ROI was accepted. Water candidate is retained as excluded because no H5 nominal coordinate center intersects it.
metadata.boundary_method: Manual image-only polygon digitization; nominal pulse centers are used only afterward for sample membership.
